tool.name: Biomni: Count Bacterial Colonies
tool.description: Count bacterial colonies from an image of agar plate using computer vision techniques.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.microbiology import count_bacterial_colonies
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = count_bacterial_colonies(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --image_path '$image_path' #if $dilution_factor --dilution_factor '$dilution_factor' #end if #if $plate_area_cm2 --plate_area_cm2 '$plate_area_cm2' #end if #if $output_dir --output_dir '$output_dir' #end if

param.name: image_path
param.label: Image Path
param.help: Path to the image file containing bacterial colonies on agar plate

param.name: dilution_factor
param.label: Dilution Factor
param.help: Dilution factor of the plated sample (default=1)

param.name: plate_area_cm2
param.label: Plate Area Cm2
param.help: Area of the agar plate in square centimeters (default=65.0, standard Petri dish)

param.label: Output Dir

tool.help:
**Biomni: Count Bacterial Colonies**
Count bacterial colonies from an image of agar plate using computer vision techniques.
Parameters ---------- image_path : str Path to the image file containing bacterial colonies on agar plate dilution_factor : float Dilution factor of the plated sample (default=1) plate_area_cm2 : float Area of the agar plate in square centimeters (default=65.0, standard Petri dish) output_dir : str Directory to save output images and results (default="./output")
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the colony counting process and results
**Domain**: microbiology **Function**: count_bacterial_colonies
